examples.en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.
examples.zh: 他下意识地抓住了她的胳膊，试图留住她。

examples.en: It is also fascinating how our subconscious mind shapes our health.
examples.zh: 我们的潜意识影响我们健康的方式也是很有趣的。

examples.en: Your subconscious mind will give you compound interest in all these fields of expression.
examples.zh: 你的潜意识将会为你带来所有这些领域的复合利息。
